bug_semantics: A negotiated WebRTC peer can send a checksum-valid SCTP SACK chunk whose 16-bit gap-ACK-block and duplicate-TSN counts are inconsistent with its declared chunk length. SctpSackChunk.ParseChunk trusted those attacker-controlled counts as loop bounds and repeatedly called unchecked NetConvert.ParseUInt16/ParseUInt32 beyond the SACK value and eventually beyond the reused 262144-byte receive buffer. The resulting IndexOutOfRangeException bypassed the receive loop's recoverable ApplicationException handler, reached the generic Exception handler, and broke the only SCTP receive thread, permanently denying the association and all data channels.
flaw_origin: Commit e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31 replaced the parent parser's stored count fields and unimplemented "TODO: Parse reports" with two concrete count-driven parsing loops in src/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs, but did not bound either wire count by chunkLen or the available buffer. That is the smallest commit that created the exploitable unchecked iteration; the direct parent read the counts but did not iterate over attacker-selected report entries.
ai_marker: absent — the raw BIC commit object has author `Aaron Clauson <aaron@sipsorcery.com> 1617466617 +0100`, committer `Aaron Clauson <aaron@sipsorcery.com> 1618069363 +0100`, subject `Wired up gap blocks and duplicate TSN count to SACK chunk.`, and no body or trailers; there is no bot identity, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI marker.
evidence: First-party advisory: https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/security/advisories/GHSA-jwjp-4649-v8jp identifies nuget:SIPSorcery <=10.0.13, first patched 10.0.14, and references direct fix https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/commit/a2466550bb2a28821c73fb1961bc33dcc467f8cf.

`git log -L 140,163:src/SIPSorcery/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs` followed the later path move and traced the vulnerable count reads/loops through move commit aebe49c58ff01857fa800e1ae323b0503eda4fb7 to e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31. The BIC patch is reviewable at https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/commit/e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31 and the introduced parser lines at https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/blob/e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31/src/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs#L138-L163 show `numGapAckBlocks` and `numDuplicateTSNs` directly controlling unbounded 4-byte parsing loops.

Direct-parent tree verification with `git show 411af73e97b450b181978b7ad937819c513f3f7c:src/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs` showed the count fields were only assigned and report parsing ended at `// TODO: Parse reports`; neither vulnerable loop existed. Parent source: https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/blob/411af73e97b450b181978b7ad937819c513f3f7c/src/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs#L111-L132. `git diff 411af73e97b450b181978b7ad937819c513f3f7c e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31` confirms the BIC itself added both loops.

The affected tag boundary is corroborated by history: `git describe --tags --abbrev=0 411af73e97b450b181978b7ad937819c513f3f7c` returned v5.1.5-pre, which does not contain the BIC; the first tag by creation date containing it is v5.1.6-pre (2021-04-10), and the first stable tag observed containing it is v5.2.0. Thus this exact mechanism begins with v5.1.6-pre/v5.2.0 stable and persists through the advisory's upper affected boundary v10.0.13.

Boundary ancestry and tree checks: v10.0.13 resolves to bdff69e7372cd5940bb5e2f48ef9f01a0ade6638, contains e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31, does not contain a2466550bb2a28821c73fb1961bc33dcc467f8cf, and visibly retains the unchecked loops at https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/blob/bdff69e7372cd5940bb5e2f48ef9f01a0ade6638/src/SIPSorcery/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs#L134-L165. v10.0.14 resolves to 7b42dc1cec9563ac868dc91438b30d811b4d9e41, contains the fix, and has the fixed length checks at https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/blob/7b42dc1cec9563ac868dc91438b30d811b4d9e41/src/SIPSorcery/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs#L135-L181.

The vulnerable v10.0.13 attack path is source-confirmed: SctpPacket only checks a chunk header minimum and `posn + chunkLength <= length` at https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/blob/bdff69e7372cd5940bb5e2f48ef9f01a0ade6638/src/SIPSorcery/net/SCTP/SctpPacket.cs#L185-L203; NetConvert indexes directly at https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/blob/bdff69e7372cd5940bb5e2f48ef9f01a0ade6638/src/SIPSorcery/sys/Net/NetConvert.cs#L28-L41; RTCSctpTransport allocates the 262144-byte buffer and parses into it at https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/blob/bdff69e7372cd5940bb5e2f48ef9f01a0ade6638/src/SIPSorcery/net/WebRTC/RTCSctpTransport.cs#L278-L302, while its ApplicationException/generic-Exception catch split at lines 345-359 makes the out-of-range failure terminate the loop; the receive thread is created and started once at lines 173-176.

Direct fix a2466550bb2a28821c73fb1961bc33dcc467f8cf has parent 70a3219bbcd2ca42bac2bf83ca903d7e03dceb23 and modifies src/SIPSorcery/net/SCTP/Chunks/SctpSackChunk.cs to reject chunks shorter than fixed parameters and reject `requiredLen > chunkLen` before either loop. It also adds defense-in-depth recoverable handling for IndexOutOfRangeException/ArgumentException in src/SIPSorcery/net/WebRTC/RTCSctpTransport.cs and regression coverage in test/unit/net/SCTP/SctpChunkUnitTest.cs. The fix is exactly the commit referenced by the advisory and is first present at the declared patched tag v10.0.14.

BIC-only attribution was checked with `git cat-file commit e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31`; the complete raw object contains only the human Aaron Clauson author/committer headers and the one-line subject, with no trailers or AI marker: https://github.com/sipsorcery-org/sipsorcery/commit/e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31.
reasoning: The vulnerability is specifically the transition from merely recording SACK counts to trusting them as iteration bounds. The parent tree proves that transition had not yet occurred: it parsed the two count words but left report parsing unimplemented. The single-parent e8f32451ede6430766edfe7753c220f83aca1d31 patch directly introduced both loops and their unchecked NetConvert reads, so it is a smaller and causally earlier BIC than the 2026 repository-layout move or the later fix; it is an ordinary commit, not a squash requiring member decomposition. In a full SCTP packet the report cursor begins at offset 28, and a 0xffff gap count advances four bytes per iteration until it reaches index 262144, outside the receive buffer. IndexOutOfRangeException is not an ApplicationException, so the generic handler breaks the sole receive loop. The mechanism is present from the first descendant release tag v5.1.6-pre (v5.2.0 stable), remains present in v10.0.13, and is absent after a2466550bb2a28821c73fb1961bc33dcc467f8cf in v10.0.14, which validates the required report length before iteration and adds receive-loop defense in depth. Finally, the complete BIC commit object has no AI authorship/co-authorship marker and names the same human as author and committer. Under BIC-only attribution, later-commit signals are irrelevant, so the supported closed verdict is NOT_AI.
